description: This Java source file defines the 'PortalPageWorker' class, which provides utility methods for managing portal pages within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for rendering portal pages, retrieving portal pages and individual portal page details, and checking user permissions for configuration.

classes.name: PortalPageWorker
classes.description: A utility class for handling portal page operations such as rendering, retrieval, and permission checks in OFBiz.

methods.name: renderPortalPageAsTextExt
methods.description: Renders the portal page as a text string given delegation, page ID, template context, and cache flag.

methods.name: getPortalPages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of portal pages that share the parentPortalPageId; considers user-specific private pages.

methods.name: getPortalPage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific portal page by ID, prioritizing user-specific private pages if they exist.

methods.name: userIsAllowedToConfigure
methods.description: Checks whether the user has permission to configure the specified portal page, based on ownership or admin rights.
